from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialReport(BaseModel):
    """One company's financial report containing the total profit for the reported period."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as it appears in the document")
    profit_label: str | None = Field(description="The label of the profit item as written (e.g. '利润总额')")
    profit_value: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of total profit; negative means loss")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit, e.g. '元'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g. '2024年第一季度'")
    quote: str = Field(description="Short verbatim excerpt containing the profit amount")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_financial_reports: list[CompanyFinancialReport]
